scope_note: Keep explicit workbench intent and current account/pair ownership through background-candidate handoff and canonical actual-reply readback. Real production coordinator plus two production Host compositions and real isolated DSH processes prove integration; this does not claim physical Mac/Windows native UI or overnight acceptance. Existing installed 0.1.94 connectivity after user login is a separate observation.

real_commands.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not $env:DSHKER_SERVER_BINARY -or -not $env:DSHKER_TEST_HARNESS_ROOT) { throw 'Explicit coordinator and real Harness inputs required' }; Set-Location networking; go test -json -race ./integration -run '^TestHostsSameNATColdRestoreDirectoryAndCandidatesRealDSH$' -count=1 -timeout=180s | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 ../.run/connection-busy/real-coordinator-gate.jsonl; exit $LASTEXITCODE"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "node tools/tests/account-session-ui.mjs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $proof = Get-Content .run/connection-busy/account-ui/latest-run.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $proof.artifactDirectory 'ledger.jsonl') -Destination .run/connection-busy/account-ui/ledger.jsonl"
